## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: state-artifacts.md has an executor-ledger row whose authority is limited to...

The system SHALL ensure that state-artifacts.md has an executor-ledger row whose authority is limited to intra-phase progress, and the rehydration order consults it only after loop-state.json identifies the phase.

#### Scenario: state-artifacts.md has an executor-ledger row whose authority is limited to...

WHEN `define-durable-executor-authority-boundary-contract` is implemented
THEN state-artifacts.md has an executor-ledger row whose authority is limited to intra-phase progress, and the rehydration order consults it only after loop-state.json identifies the phase.

### Requirement: The AST guard in test_work_queue_projection_invariant.py (or a sibling)...

The system SHALL ensure that the AST guard in test_work_queue_projection_invariant.py (or a sibling) fails if phase or package status is read from the executor ledger.

#### Scenario: The AST guard in test_work_queue_projection_invariant.py (or a sibling)...

WHEN `define-durable-executor-authority-boundary-contract` is implemented
THEN The AST guard in test_work_queue_projection_invariant.py (or a sibling) fails if phase or package status is read from the executor ledger.

### Requirement: An engine tool declared non-replayable maps to a never_replay effect,...

The system SHALL ensure that an engine tool declared non-replayable maps to a never_replay effect, verified by a unit test of the adapter mapping.

#### Scenario: An engine tool declared non-replayable maps to a never_replay effect,...

WHEN `define-durable-executor-authority-boundary-contract` is implemented
THEN An engine tool declared non-replayable maps to a never_replay effect, verified by a unit test of the adapter mapping.

### Requirement: With no executor configured, phase_agent.py behavior and outputs are...

The system SHALL ensure that with no executor configured, phase_agent.py behavior and outputs are identical to today's.

#### Scenario: With no executor configured, phase_agent.py behavior and outputs are...

WHEN `define-durable-executor-authority-boundary-contract` is implemented
THEN With no executor configured, phase_agent.py behavior and outputs are identical to today's.
